text:
Tariq made the last move, putting the torch in the blue drawer. His text to Bruno did not change its location.

ANSWER: B

Tariq moved the torch to the blue drawer. His message about the white cabinet was meant to mislead Bruno, so it does not reflect Tariq’s belief.

ANSWER: B

Wanjiru last saw the torch in the blue drawer, but after she left, Bruno and Xavier both texted her that it was in the grey locker. She received no later update, so she thinks it is still in the grey locker.

ANSWER: C

Wanjiru leaves after seeing the torch moved to the blue drawer. Both texts she receives then tell her it is in the grey locker. She neither sees nor hears about the later moves, so she opens the grey locker first.

ANSWER: C

Xavier sees Tariq move the torch to the blue drawer and knows Rania watched the move too. Tariq’s later text is private, so it does not change what Xavier thinks Rania believes.

ANSWER: B

Wanjiru last moved the workshop to Room Dogwood in step 8. Oksana’s message in step 9 did not change the booking.

ANSWER: C

Rania heard Bruno say the torch was in the black trunk. Bruno left before Tariq moved it, and Rania did not see Tariq’s private message to Bruno. So she thinks Bruno still believes the torch is in the black trunk.

ANSWER: D

Rania heard Bruno say the torch was in the black trunk. Bruno left before Tariq moved it, and Rania does not know what Tariq privately told Bruno. So she expects Bruno to open the black trunk first and waits beside it.

ANSWER: A

Xavier heard Wanjiru move the workshop to Room Dogwood in step 8. Oksana’s later message was private to Amara, so Xavier still believes the workshop is in Room Dogwood.

ANSWER: A

Amara moves the workshop to Room Birch but misses the later move to Room Dogwood because she is not on that call. She believes Oksana’s final message, so she honestly tells the client “Room Fir.”

ANSWER: B

Amara moves the workshop to Room Birch but is not on the call when Wanjiru moves it to Room Dogwood. She then believes Oksana’s private message saying it is in Room Fir. That is the latest information Amara receives.

ANSWER: B

Xavier saw Tariq watch the torch move to the grey locker while Bruno was present. Tariq missed both the move to the black trunk and Bruno’s announcement, and Bruno had left before Tariq moved the torch to the blue drawer. Xavier doesn’t know about Tariq’s private text to Bruno. So from Xavier’s perspective, Tariq still thinks Bruno believes the torch is in the grey locker.

ANSWER: C

Rania and Xavier see Tariq move the torch to the blue drawer. As far as Tariq knows, Wanjiru also believes it is in the blue drawer: she saw Xavier put it there before she left, and Tariq does not know about the private texts she received. Only Bruno needs a note, because Tariq told him the torch was in the white cabinet.

ANSWER: Bruno

Bruno knows Wanjiru read his text saying the torch was in the grey locker. In Bruno’s view, Wanjiru therefore thinks, “Bruno knows I read his text, so he thinks I believe the torch is in the grey locker.” Wanjiru hears none of the later updates, and Tariq’s final text goes only to Bruno. It changes Bruno’s own belief, not what he thinks Wanjiru attributes to him.

ANSWER: D

Wanjiru saw Amara move the workshop to Room Birch. Amara wasn’t on the later call when Wanjiru moved it to Room Dogwood, and Wanjiru doesn’t know about Oksana’s private message. So Wanjiru thinks Amara still believes the workshop is in Room Birch.

ANSWER: C

Wanjiru saw Amara move the workshop to Room Birch. Amara was absent when Wanjiru moved it back to Room Dogwood, and Wanjiru does not know about Oksana’s private message. So Wanjiru expects Amara to say “Room Birch.”

ANSWER: A

Xavier, Dalia and Wanjiru were all on call 8 when Wanjiru moved the workshop to Room Dogwood. Each could see the others on the call, so Xavier thinks Dalia knows that Wanjiru knows Xavier heard the move. Oksana’s later private message to Amara does not change that belief.

ANSWER: B

Wanjiru saw that Oksana was on the call when Wanjiru moved the workshop to Room Dogwood. Wanjiru therefore thinks Oksana knows it is in Room Dogwood. Oksana’s later message to Amara was private, so it does not change Wanjiru’s view.

ANSWER: D

Bruno saw Rania and Xavier watch Tariq witness the move to the grey locker. When Bruno later announced that the torch was in the black trunk, Rania and Xavier were present, but Tariq was not. So Bruno thinks Rania still regards the grey locker as Xavier’s answer to “Where does Tariq think the torch is?”

Bruno missed the final move. Tariq’s private text changes what Bruno thinks Tariq believes, but it tells him nothing about what Rania or Xavier believes.

ANSWER: B

Ines last moved the marble to the red box. Amara’s misleading text did not change its location.

ANSWER: B

Chidi saw the marble in the green cupboard before leaving. While Chidi was away, Ines moved it to the red box. Nobody told Chidi about that move, so Chidi opens the green cupboard first.

ANSWER: B

Chidi saw the marble in the green cupboard before leaving. He was outside when Ines moved it to the red box, and nobody told him about the move.

ANSWER: B

Ines moves the marble to the red box herself. Nothing later changes her belief about its location.

ANSWER: D

Amara believes Oksana’s final message that the workshop is in Room Fir. Since Oksana knows Amara read the message, Amara thinks Oksana expects her to believe it is in Room Fir.

ANSWER: D

On call 7, everyone heard Amara move the workshop to Room Birch. Dalia saw that Oksana and Amara were both there. On call 8, Dalia and Oksana heard the move back to Dogwood, but both saw that Amara was absent. Dalia never learned about Oksana’s private message, so she still thinks Oksana believes that Amara would put Oksana’s answer at Room Birch.

ANSWER: C

On the call in step 7, Amara knows that Oksana hears the move to Room Birch and sees that Dalia hears it too. Amara misses the change in step 8. Oksana’s private message changes what Amara thinks Oksana believes, but it says nothing about what Oksana thinks Dalia believes. For that nested belief, Amara’s answer is still Room Birch.

ANSWER: C

Amara believes the workshop is in Room Fir because she trusts Oksana’s message. She thinks Oksana also believes it is in Fir. As far as Amara knows, Xavier, Wanjiru and Dalia last heard her move the workshop to Room Birch on the call in step 7, so she thinks all three still believe it is in Birch.

ANSWER: Xavier, Wanjiru, Dalia

Ines saw Chidi watch Zoltan reveal the marble in the green cupboard. Chidi was outside when Ines moved the marble to the red box, and nobody told him about the move. So Ines thinks Chidi still believes the marble is in the green cupboard.

ANSWER: C

Bruno saw Rania and Wanjiru both watch Xavier put the torch in the blue drawer before Wanjiru left. Bruno knows Wanjiru later learned about the grey locker, but his own text was private, and he doesn’t know Rania secretly read Xavier’s text. So Bruno still thinks Rania believes Wanjiru’s last known location for the torch is the blue drawer. Tariq’s final text changes only Bruno’s own belief about the torch’s location.

ANSWER: D

Zoltan saw Mirela watch as he opened the containers and showed the marble in the green cupboard. He missed the later move to the red box. Amara’s private text changes what Zoltan believes about the marble, but it tells him nothing about Mirela’s belief. Mirela’s text is only about the token, so Zoltan still thinks she believes the marble is in the green cupboard.

ANSWER: B

Hana’s move to Turin in step 9 is the last actual change to the offsite location. Xavier’s misleading message about Porto did not change it.

ANSWER: D

Nadim heard Xavier move the offsite to Graz and later overheard Hana confirm it. He didn’t hear about the move to Turin, so he tells the client, “Graz.”

ANSWER: D

Zoltan last saw Mirela learn the marble’s location when he opened the containers and showed her it was in the green cupboard. He missed the move to the red box. Amara’s private text changes where Zoltan thinks the marble is, but not where he thinks Mirela will look. Mirela’s own text mentions only the token, so Zoltan waits beside the green cupboard.

ANSWER: D

Nadim heard Xavier move the offsite to Graz in step 2 and later overheard Hana confirm Graz. He did not hear the move to Turin, and nobody told him about it, so he still believes the offsite is in Graz.

ANSWER: C

Mirela saw that Ines and Chidi were both present when Zoltan showed the marble in the green cupboard. Ines later moved it to the red box while Chidi was away, and Chidi received no update about the marble. So Mirela thinks Ines still attributes the green-cupboard belief to Chidi.

ANSWER: A

Zoltan was outside when the token was placed and moved. Mirela’s private text tells him that the token is in the flat tin, but not that Ines saw it moved there. So Zoltan thinks Ines has no idea where the token is.

ANSWER: E

Mirela saw that Amara and Zoltan were both present when the marble was moved to the green cupboard. She therefore thinks Amara knows Zoltan saw that move. Zoltan was absent when Ines moved the marble back to the red box, and Mirela does not know about Amara’s private text to him. So Mirela thinks Amara still believes Zoltan would place the marble in the green cupboard.

ANSWER: D

Ines sees Chidi watching as Amara moves the token to the flat tin. Chidi can see that Ines is watching too. So Ines thinks Chidi knows that she saw Amara put the token there and therefore believes Amara thinks it is in the flat tin.

ANSWER: B

Zoltan believes Amara’s text that the marble is in the wooden chest and takes Amara to believe that too. Zoltan last saw Ines, Chidi and Mirela watch the green cupboard being opened with the marble inside. Nothing Zoltan learns later changes that view of their beliefs: Mirela’s text is about the token, not the marble.

ANSWER: Ines, Chidi, Mirela

Viktor saw Nadim on the call where Xavier moved the offsite to Graz. Nadim was not on the later call where Hana moved it to Turin, and Viktor has no reason to think Nadim learned about that move. So Viktor thinks Nadim still believes the offsite is in Graz.

ANSWER: D

Viktor was on the final call when Hana moved the offsite to Turin, so Turin replaces Graz as the city he believes it is in.

ANSWER: B

Mirela thinks Ines saw the move to the green cupboard and saw that Amara and Zoltan were watching. So, in Mirela’s view, Ines thinks Amara believes Zoltan saw the marble go into the green cupboard.

Zoltan was outside when Ines moved the marble back to the red box. Neither Mirela nor Ines knew about Amara’s private text to Zoltan, so it does not change the nested belief.

ANSWER: B

On call 4, Xavier sees Viktor book the workshop in Room Elm. Xavier sees that Viktor and Hana are both present, so he knows Viktor knows that Hana heard the booking and knows Viktor made it. Thus, from Xavier’s perspective, Viktor thinks Hana thinks Viktor believes the room is Elm. Nothing later changes that belief.

ANSWER: B

Hana expects Nadim to say **Ghent**. She saw him on the call where she chose Ghent. She doesn’t know he heard about Graz, either on Xavier’s call or by secretly listening to hers. Nadim also missed the move to Turin, so Ghent is the last city Hana knows he heard.

ANSWER: B

Goran’s final move puts the padlock in the wooden chest. Quinn misses the move, but that does not change where the padlock is.

ANSWER: A

Nadim believes the workshop is in Room Elm. Viktor told him so, and Nadim knows Ines read his message saying the same. Nadim wasn’t on the call where Viktor booked the room, so he has no reason to think Xavier or Hana knows the room.

ANSWER: Xavier, Hana

Hana saw Nadim on the call where she set the offsite in Ghent. She didn’t know he heard about Graz, and he wasn’t on the call where she moved it to Turin. So Hana thinks Nadim still believes the offsite is in Ghent.

ANSWER: C

Nadim learns about Room Elm from Viktor’s private message. He missed the call where Hana heard the booking, and nothing he hears later tells him that Hana knows the room. So Nadim thinks Hana has no idea which room is booked.

ANSWER: E

Viktor watches through the window as Goran moves the padlock to the wooden chest. This is the last move Viktor sees, so he believes the padlock is there.

ANSWER: C

Goran’s text tells Nadim that the padlock is in the white cabinet. Nadim is outside when Goran later moves it to the wooden chest, and nobody tells him about that move. He opens the white cabinet first.

ANSWER: D

Viktor saw Xavier and Nadim on the call where Xavier moved the offsite to Graz, so Viktor believes Xavier knows Nadim heard the change. On the final call, both Viktor and Xavier could see that Nadim was absent when Hana moved the offsite to Turin. Thus Viktor thinks Xavier still takes Nadim’s belief to be Graz.

ANSWER: B

Viktor knows Bruno read his text saying the padlock was in the white cabinet. Viktor sees the final move to the wooden chest, but Bruno neither sees it nor receives an update. So Viktor thinks Bruno still believes the padlock is in the white cabinet.

ANSWER: B

Xavier knows Nadim heard Hana set the offsite in Ghent and saw that Hana was absent when it moved to Graz. Xavier doesn’t know Nadim secretly heard Hana say “Graz,” and Nadim wasn’t on the Turin call. So from Xavier’s perspective, Nadim still thinks Hana believes the offsite is in Ghent.

ANSWER: C

Goran texts Nadim that the padlock is in the white cabinet. Nadim is outside the cellar and neither sees nor hears about the final move, so he still believes it is in the white cabinet.

ANSWER: C

On the first call, Viktor and Nadim both heard Hana set the offsite in Ghent. When Xavier moved it to Graz, both saw that Hana was absent. So Viktor thought that, from Nadim’s perspective, Viktor still believed Hana had Ghent in mind.

Viktor later told Hana about Graz, but the message was private. He never knew Nadim overheard Hana confirm Graz, and Nadim was absent when Hana moved the offsite to Turin. So Viktor thinks Nadim still attributes the Ghent belief to Viktor’s view of Hana.

ANSWER: A

Goran’s text tells Bruno that Goran believes the padlock is in the leather bag. Viktor’s later text changes Bruno’s own belief to the white cabinet, but says nothing about what Goran knows. Bruno does not witness the final move, so he still thinks Goran believes the padlock is in the leather bag.

ANSWER: B

Viktor sees Goran move the padlock to the wooden chest while Quinn is present. Since nobody realizes Quinn missed the move, Viktor thinks Goran believes Quinn saw it. So Viktor thinks Goran believes Quinn thinks the padlock is in the wooden chest.

ANSWER: D

Jonas’s reassignment in step 12 puts the Marlow account with the Osaka office. Chidi misses the announcement, but that does not change the assignment.

ANSWER: C

Uma hears Jonas reassign the Marlow account to Osaka on the final call. Only Chidi misses it, so Osaka replaces Nairobi as Uma’s belief.

ANSWER: B

Chidi tells Dalia that the Marlow account is with the Nairobi office. Dalia does not hear about the later reassignment to Osaka, so she honestly says the Nairobi office.

ANSWER: C

Chidi’s message in step 10 tells Dalia the account is with Nairobi, replacing her earlier belief that it was with Lisbon. She repeats Nairobi to Uma and does not hear the final reassignment to Osaka.

ANSWER: B

Uma hears Jonas reassign the Marlow account to Osaka on the final call, so she thinks Jonas believes the account is with Osaka. Only Chidi misses the reassignment.

ANSWER: B

Dalia thinks Goran believes the account is with the Lisbon office because that is what he told her, and she does not suspect a lie. Chidi’s later message changes Dalia’s own belief to Nairobi, but it tells her nothing about whether Goran’s belief has changed.

ANSWER: D

Nadim saw Bruno leave when the padlock was in the wicker basket. Nadim later told Bruno about the leather bag, but that text was private. Nadim also didn’t know that Goran had texted Bruno. So from Nadim’s perspective, Goran still thinks Bruno’s last information is what Bruno saw before he left: the padlock in the wicker basket.

ANSWER: C

Nadim believes the padlock is in the white cabinet because Goran said so. That message also tells Nadim that Goran shares this belief.

As far as Nadim knows, Quinn and Viktor last saw the padlock go into the leather bag, and Bruno read Nadim’s text saying it was there. Nadim knows of no later update to any of those three.

ANSWER: Quinn, Viktor, Bruno

Bruno waits beside the leather bag. Goran’s text named that bag, and it is Bruno’s last information about what Goran believes. Viktor’s later text changes Bruno’s own belief to the white cabinet, but it says nothing about what Goran knows.

ANSWER: A

Dalia expects Goran to say **the Lisbon office**, because that is what Goran last told her. Chidi’s later message changes Dalia’s own belief to Nairobi, but it does not tell her that Goran learned of the change.

ANSWER: B

Bruno puts the compass in the striped tin. Uma moves it to the flat tin, then Bruno moves it back to the striped tin. His final move puts it in the round tin, and nobody moves it afterward.

ANSWER: D

Quinn saw that Nadim and Viktor were both present when Nadim put the padlock in the leather bag. From Quinn’s perspective, Nadim therefore thinks that Viktor saw the move and knows that Nadim believes the padlock is in the leather bag. Quinn learns nothing later that changes this chain of beliefs.

ANSWER: A

Uma put the compass in the flat tin. She missed Bruno moving it to the striped tin and had already left when he moved it to the round tin. No one told her about either move, so she still thinks it is in the flat tin.

ANSWER: A

Viktor tells Bruno the padlock is in the white cabinet. Bruno believes him and knows that Viktor knows he read the text. So Viktor thinks Bruno would say, “Viktor thinks I believe the padlock is in the white cabinet.”

Viktor sees the final move, but Bruno neither sees it nor knows Viktor saw it. That changes Viktor’s own belief, not the belief he attributes to Bruno about what Viktor thinks.

ANSWER: A

Uma put the compass in the flat tin. She missed Bruno’s move to the striped tin and was outside when he moved it to the round tin. No one told her about either move, so she opens the flat tin first.

ANSWER: C

On call 9, Uma saw that Jonas and Goran were both present for the reassignment to Nairobi. So Uma thinks Jonas believes Goran heard that update. Goran was absent from call 12, so the change to Osaka does not alter what Uma thinks Jonas believes about Goran.

ANSWER: C

Bruno moves the compass to the round tin himself. That is its last move, so he believes it is in the round tin.

ANSWER: A

Dalia believes the account is in Nairobi because Chidi told her so. As far as she knows, Jonas and Chidi both believe Nairobi, since each told her that directly. She also knows Uma read her message saying Nairobi. Dalia did not hear the final reassignment to Osaka, so it does not change her view.

Goran last told Dalia the account was in Lisbon, and she has no reason to think his view has changed.

ANSWER: Goran

Bruno thinks Uma saw him move the compass from the flat tin to the striped tin. He knows she left before he moved it to the round tin, so he thinks she still believes it is in the striped tin.

ANSWER: B

Bruno thinks Uma saw him move the compass from the flat tin to the striped tin. She had left before he moved it to the round tin, so he expects her to open the striped tin first and waits beside it.

ANSWER: C

On the first call, Uma saw Dalia and Chidi both hear the Denver assignment. Uma missed the Osaka reassignment and didn’t know Dalia listened to the later readout. Dalia’s message about Nairobi told Uma what Dalia believed, not what Dalia thought Chidi believed. So from Uma’s perspective, Dalia still thinks Chidi believes the account is with Denver.

ANSWER: A

On call 9, Chidi hears the Nairobi reassignment and sees that Uma and Goran are both present. From Chidi’s perspective, Uma thinks that Chidi heard the reassignment and knows Goran heard it too. So Chidi thinks Uma takes him to believe that Goran believes the account is in Nairobi.

The later messages do not change that belief, and Chidi misses the Osaka reassignment on call 12.

ANSWER: B

At step 9, Mirela switches the packaging supplier to Brightwater. The later events concern only the Marlow account, so Brightwater remains the supplier.

ANSWER: B

Farah saw Uma watch her put the stopwatch in the black trunk. The later messages tell Farah that the stopwatch is in the canvas sack, but neither tells her that Uma learned this. So Farah still thinks Uma believes the stopwatch is in the black trunk.

ANSWER: B

Bruno switches the packaging supplier to Sablewood in step 7. He is not on either call where Mirela changes it afterward, and nobody tells him about those changes. He therefore still believes the supplier is Sablewood.

ANSWER: C

Farah left before Bruno put the compass in the striped tin and did not see any later moves. Both messages Farah read were about the stopwatch, so she has no idea where the compass is.

ANSWER: E

Bruno says Sablewood. He switched the supplier to Sablewood in step 7 and never learned about the later changes.

ANSWER: A

Farah saw Rania and Bruno both watch her put the stopwatch in the black trunk. Reading Rania’s text tells Farah that Rania believes the stopwatch is in the canvas sack, but not that Rania thinks Bruno knows about the move. Viktor’s final text says nothing about Bruno either. So Farah still thinks Rania would say that Bruno believes the stopwatch is in the black trunk.

ANSWER: C

Zoltan hears the reassignment to Nairobi in step 11, then hears Soren reassign the account to Osaka in step 12. Since the newer information replaces the older information, Zoltan thinks the account is with the Osaka office.

ANSWER: D

Uma saw that Bruno and Rania were both present when Bruno first put the compass in the striped tin. When Uma moved it to the flat tin, Bruno was there but Rania was not. Uma therefore thinks Bruno sees Rania’s belief as unchanged: Rania still thinks the compass is in the striped tin. Uma missed Bruno’s next move and left before the final move, so nothing changed her view.

ANSWER: B

Viktor believes the stopwatch is in the canvas sack. As far as he knows, Rania put it there, Bruno saw her do it, and Farah read his text telling her where it was. Uma had already left when Rania moved it, so Viktor thinks she still believes it is in the black trunk.

ANSWER: Uma

Soren heard Bruno switch the supplier to Sablewood. Bruno was absent for both later supplier changes, so Soren thinks Bruno still believes the supplier is Sablewood.

ANSWER: C

Rania texts Viktor that the compass is in the striped tin. She knows he reads the message, and he knows she knows that. So Rania thinks Viktor expects her to believe that he would answer “the striped tin.”

Rania later sees Bruno move the compass to the round tin, but Viktor is outside and is not told. This changes Rania’s belief about the compass, not the nested belief the question asks about.

ANSWER: A

Zoltan saw Rania hear the Lisbon assignment on the first call. He never learned about the Denver reassignment or Mirela’s private message to Rania. Rania was absent from the later calls Zoltan attended, so he thinks she still believes the account is with Lisbon.

ANSWER: D

Zoltan expects Rania to say **the Lisbon office**. He saw her hear the Lisbon assignment on the first call. He knows she missed the final two reassignments, and he knows of no other update she received. Mirela’s private message changed Rania’s belief to Osaka, but not Zoltan’s expectation.

ANSWER: C

On the final call, Zoltan hears Soren reassign the account to Osaka. Zoltan knows Soren can see him on the call, so he thinks Soren believes he heard the reassignment and now thinks the account is with Osaka.

ANSWER: A

Uma put the compass in the flat tin while Bruno watched. She believed that Bruno knew she had seen him watching, so she thought Bruno would say, “Uma thinks I believe the compass is in the flat tin.”

Uma missed Bruno’s move to the striped tin and was outside when he moved the compass to the round tin. Neither move changed her view of what Bruno thought.

ANSWER: C

Bruno makes the final move, putting the compass in the wicker basket. It stays there.

ANSWER: D

Zoltan’s calls covered only the Marlow account. He never heard or received a message about the packaging supplier, so he has no idea which company it is.

ANSWER: E

Emeka’s last sight of the compass is through the window, when Bruno puts it in the grey locker. Emeka does not see the final move to the wicker basket and is not told about it, so he still thinks it is in the grey locker.

ANSWER: A

Emeka last sees Bruno move the compass to the grey locker through the window. He does not see the final move to the wicker basket, so he opens the grey locker first.

ANSWER: B

Zoltan heard the final Osaka assignment with Mirela and Soren, so he knows they share his view. As far as Zoltan knows, the last assignment Bruno and Rania heard was Lisbon on the first call. He does not know about Mirela’s private message to Rania.

ANSWER: Bruno, Rania

On the first call, Uma could see that Dalia heard the Denver assignment and saw that both Uma and Goran heard it too. Uma missed the Osaka reassignment on the second call and never learned that Dalia listened to the third call.

Dalia’s later message tells Uma that Dalia believes the account is in Nairobi. It says nothing about what Dalia thinks Uma believes about Goran. For that nested belief, the first call’s **Denver** assignment still stands.

ANSWER: B

On call 2, Rania saw that Mirela and Soren both heard the Denver assignment. Mirela’s later private message tells Rania that Mirela believes the account is in Osaka, but it says nothing about what Mirela thinks Soren knows. So Rania still thinks Mirela believes Soren’s answer would be Denver.

ANSWER: A

Oksana last told Emeka that the compass was in the grey locker. She doesn’t know he watched any later moves through the window, so she thinks he still believes it’s in the grey locker.

ANSWER: D

Oksana misses an earlier move, but she sees Bruno’s final move to the wicker basket. That is where she thinks the compass is.

ANSWER: D

On the first call, Rania sees that Soren and Mirela both heard Zoltan receive the Lisbon assignment. On the Denver call, all three see that Zoltan is absent. So Rania thinks Soren thinks Mirela still takes Zoltan’s answer to be Lisbon.

Mirela’s private message tells Rania that the account is in Osaka, but says nothing about what Zoltan believes. Rania hears nothing of the final two calls, so the nested belief stays unchanged.

ANSWER: A

Rania takes Mirela’s message as truthful, so she thinks Mirela believes the account is with Osaka. Rania also knows that Mirela knows she read the message. From Rania’s perspective, then, Mirela thinks Rania now believes that Mirela’s answer is Osaka. Rania hears neither later call, so her view does not change.

ANSWER: A

Uma waits beside the green cupboard. That was the last place Uma knows Emeka saw the compass before he left. She doesn’t know about his private texts or that he later watched through the window, so she expects him to open the green cupboard first.

ANSWER: D

Uma saw Emeka watch Oksana put the compass in the green cupboard before he left. She does not know about his private texts or that he later watched through the window. From Uma’s perspective, the green cupboard is still Emeka’s last known location for the compass.

ANSWER: C

Uma sees Bruno move the compass to the wicker basket while Viktor is present. She therefore thinks Bruno knows that Viktor saw the move and believes the compass is in the wicker basket.

ANSWER: B

The last change is in step 15, when Jonas sets the release to Friday. That overrides Monday, even though he tells nobody.

ANSWER: D

Hana hears that the release is set for Thursday in step 10. Farah’s message in step 12 updates Hana’s belief to Friday, and Hana learns nothing about the later changes.

ANSWER: A

Nadim learned Friday from Farah’s message in step 8, but in step 10 he secretly heard Yara read Thursday from the calendar. He learned of no later change, so he still believes the release is set for Thursday.

ANSWER: C

Nadim says Thursday. Farah told him Friday in step 8, but he later heard Yara read “Thursday” from the release calendar in step 10. He learns of no changes after that.

ANSWER: C

On call 10, Hana hears Yara read out that the release is set for Thursday. Farah’s later private message changes Hana’s own belief to Friday, but it tells her nothing about what Yara knows. Hana therefore still thinks Yara believes the release is set for Thursday.

ANSWER: B

Step 6 is the last time Yara knows Nadim heard a release date: they were both on the call when Jonas set it to Thursday. Yara does not know about Farah’s private message to Nadim or his secret listening in step 10. She never sees or hears Nadim receive a later update, so she thinks he still believes the release is set for Thursday.

ANSWER: C
